[ce] CalcExpress - Eval Script.vi

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

The VI evaluates previously parsed CalcExpress scripts. The VI takes a reference to CalcExpress instance context that is returned by [ce] CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi. The VI uses this reference to both access parsed script and keep intermediate data. Due to the VI is reentrant, several instances of it can simultaneously evaluate scripts. Note that several evaluators can't use the same instance context at a time.

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle is a handle of a variable context. CalcExpress accesses variables with this handle. You have to pass a valid handle to this terminal if variables are used in a script; otherwise, you can keep it unwired. Use VM - Open Context.vi to open a variable context.
CE InstanceRef is a reference number for a CalcExpress instance that contains a parsed CalcExpress expression/script. CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
repeat (1) specifies number of times the VI has to evaluate a script. If it is greater than zero, the VI evaluates the script the specified number of times, and returns result of the last evaluation. If it is equal to or less than zero, the VI does not perform an evaluation. By default, repeat is equal to one (1).
params cluster specifies optional parameters that influence on evaluation.
autoVar parameter enables (TRUE) or disables (FALSE) automatic (implicit) creating variables during an evaluation. If a left-hand operand in an Assignment operator is an identifier that does not refer to an existing variable, CalcExpress creates a variable with the such name to perform an assignment if only autoVar is TRUE; otherwise an error is produced. Note that variables are created in a local variable context specified by VC Handle. By default, autoVar is TRUE.
enCpx parameter enables (TRUE) or disables (FALSE) performing operators on operands of Complex data types (suppress polymorphism feature). By default, enCpx is TRUE.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup VC Handle is a flow-through parameter with the same value as VC Handle.
dup CE InstanceRef is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CE InstanceRef.
numeric value returns value of an expression if it has DBL Number data type; otherwise it is not defined.
NOTICE: the VI returns value of an expression but not an expression-statement, which does not have a value. Don't put a semicolon after the last expression in a script if you need to obtain its value through this indicator.
value type returns datatype of expression value as enum. If a processed script does not contain an expression that produces a value (it is empty or consists of only expression-statements), value type is DBL Number.
Click here for more information on data types.

0String
1DBL Number
2identifier
31D Array of DBL
42D Array of DBL
5CDB Number
61D Array of CDB
72D Array of CDB
81D Array of String
92D Array of String
10Unknown data type
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
